LLVM (http://llvm.org/):
  LLVH version 8.0.0svn
  Optimized build

Hermes JavaScript compiler.
  Hermes release version: 0.12.0
  HBC bytecode version: 96

  Features:
    Debugger
    Contiguous Heap
    Unicode RegExp Property Escapes
    Zip file input

OVERVIEW: Hermes driver

USAGE: hermesc [options] <file1> <file2>...

OPTIONS:

Compiler Options:
These options change how JS is compiled.

  Choose optimization level:
    -O0                              - No optimizations
    -Og                              - Optimizations suitable for debugging
    -O                               - Expensive optimizations
  -Wdirect-eval                      - Enable Warning when attempting a direct (local) eval
  -Werror                            - Treat all warnings as errors, or treat warnings of a particular category as errors
    =                                -   All warnings
    =undefined-variable              -   Warning when an undefined variable is referenced
    =direct-eval                     -   Warning when attempting a direct (local) eval
    =unresolved-static-require       -   Warning when require calls cannot be resolved statically
    =misc                            -   Miscellaneous warnings
  -Wundefined-variable               - Enable Warning when an undefined variable is referenced
  -Wunresolved-static-require        - Enable Warning when require calls cannot be resolved statically
  -base-bytecode=<string>            - input base bytecode for delta optimizing mode
  -bytecode-output-manifest=<string> - Name of the manifest file generated when compiling multiple segments to bytecode
  -commonjs                          - Use CommonJS modules
  -dump-instr-uselist                - Print the use list if the instruction has any users.
  -dump-operand-registers            - Dump registers assigned to instruction operands
  -dump-source-level-scope           - Print the instruction's source-level scope.
  -dump-source-location              - Print source location information in IR/AST/bytecode dumps.
    =both                            -   Print both source location and byte range
    =loc                             -   Print only source location
    =range                           -   Print only byte range
  -dump-textified-callee             - Print the Call instruction's textified callee.
  -eager                             - Force fully eager compilation
  -emit-async-break-check            - Emit instruction to check async break request
  Choose output:
    -exec                            - Execute the provided script (default)
    -dump-ast                        - Dump the AST as text in JSON
    -dump-transformed-ast            - Dump the transformed AST as text after validation
    -dump-js                         - Dump the AST as JS
    -dump-transformed-js             - Dump the transformed AST as JS after validation
    -dump-ir                         - Dump the IR as text
    -dump-lir                        - Dump the Lowered IR as text
    -dump-ra                         - Dump the register-allocated IR as text
    -dump-lra                        - Dump register-allocated Lowered IR as text
    -dump-postra                     - Dump the Lowered IR after register allocation
    -dump-bytecode                   - Dump bytecode as text
    -emit-binary                     - Emit compiled binary
  -ferror-limit=<uint>               - Maximum number of errors (0 means unlimited)
  -finline                           - Enable inlining of functions
  recognizing of calls to global functions like Object.keys() statically
    -fstatic-builtins                - Enable static builtins.
    -fno-static-builtins             - Disable static builtins.
    -fauto-detect-static-builtins    - Automatically detect 'use static builtin' directive from the source.
  -fstatic-require                   - Enable resolving of CommonJS require() calls at compile time
  -fstrip-function-names             - Enable Strip function names to reduce string table size
  -funsafe-intrinsics                - Enable Recognize and lower Asm.js/Wasm unsafe compiler intrinsics.
  Choose debug info level:
    -g                               - Equivalent to -g3
    -g0                              - Do not emit debug info
    -g1                              - Emit location info for backtraces
    -g2                              - Emit location info for all instructions
    -g3                              - Emit full info for debugging
  -lazy                              - Force fully lazy compilation
  -max-diagnostic-width=<int>        - Preferred diagnostic maximum width
  -non-strict                        - Enable non-strict mode.
  -out=<string>                      - Output file name
  -output-source-map                 - Emit a source map to the output filename with .map extension
  -parse-flow                        - Parse Flow
  -parse-jsx                         - Parse JSX
  -parse-ts                          - Parse TypeScript
  -pretty                            - Pretty print JSON, JS or disassembled bytecode
  -source-map=<string>               - Specify a matching source map for the input JS file
  -strict                            - Enable strict mode.
  -target                            - Set the bytecode format:
    =HBC                             -   Emit HBC bytecode (default)
  -w                                 - Disable all warnings

General options:

  -b                                 - Treat the input as executable bytecode
  -basic-block-profiling             - Enable basic block profiling (HBC only)
  -enable-eval                       - Enable support for eval()
  -include-globals=<filename>        - Include the definitions of global properties (can be specified more than once)
  -optimized-eval                    - Turn on compiler optimizations in eval.
  -reuse-prop-cache                  - Reuse property cache entries for same property name

Generic Options:

  -help                              - Display available options (-help-hidden for more)
  -help-list                         - Display list of available options (-help-list-hidden for more)
  -version                           - Display the version of this program
